Environment URLs

What is the API Gateway base URL for development?

https://wepay.wevend.dev/api

What is the API Gateway base URL for Production?

https://wepay.wevend.pro/api

What is the frontend URL used for merchant claim / login?

Dev: https://wepay.wevend.dev/claim

This URL is included directly in the merchant claim email sent by WeVend — you don't need to construct it yourself. Production follows the same .pro pattern as the API base URL.

What are the iFrame base URLs for card entry (Apple Pay / Google Pay)?In doc

Source: WeVend WePay API Gateway v3.2.2, p.125 — Additional Information / iFrame Base URLs

RegionDEVProduction
Canadaiframe.wevend.deviframe.wevend.pro
USiframe-us.wevend.deviframe-us.wevend.pro
The US Dev URL is correct for Apple Pay integration.

Authentication & Tokens

For payment endpoints, do I need a merchant access token or an admin/organization token?

Payment endpoints accept either a merchant access token or an organization Global Token, depending on whether the Global Token feature is enabled on the merchant's organization.

For your integration, assume the Global Token feature will be enabled — default to using the organization global access token, not the individual merchant token.
Where do merchants and admins retrieve their access tokens?
  • After claiming their account and logging in, a merchant can view and manage their own merchant access tokens in the WePay portal.
  • If the organization has Global Token enabled, the organization's global access token is viewable in the WePay admin portal (admin credentials) or retrievable via the appropriate API.
Token expiry and refresh behavior?In doc

Source: WeVend WePay API Gateway v3.2.2 — Authentication overview

Authentication uses JWT Bearer Tokens with a 7-day expiry. Refresh tokens are single-use.

Sandbox / Test Merchant Setup

How do I get a test merchant (sandbox), test MID, and test terminal ID?

/api/merchants/admin/register is admin-only, so you cannot self-register a test merchant. The process is:

  • You provide WeVend with the email address where the merchant claim email should be sent.
  • WeVend registers the test merchant in WePay (US country) and provides a test MID and test terminal ID (termId).
  • The designated contact receives a claim email with a registration code.
  • The merchant completes the claim process and sets a password.
  • After login, the merchant can view/manage merchant access tokens (or the org's Global Token, if enabled — see Authentication).

Void & Refunds

What's the difference between voiding and refunding a transaction?In doc

Source: WeVend WePay API Gateway v3.2.2, p.72–79 — /api/payments/void & /api/payments/refund-with-token

StageAction available
Sale / Pre-Auth (not yet settled)Void
Completion (captured/settled)Refund only — void is not available
Dispute / chargebackNot covered by this API
A void cancels a Sale or Pre-Auth before it settles. Once a transaction has been completed/captured, you can no longer void it — a refund is the only option.
How do I void a transaction?In doc

Source: WeVend WePay API Gateway v3.2.2, p.72–73 — /api/payments/void

Call POST /api/payments/void with just the transactionId of the Sale or Pre-Auth you want to cancel.

  • You cannot void a Completion transaction.
  • The response returns a new transaction record for the void itself, with its own transactionId, linked back to the original via paymentOrderId.
Common use case: if a transaction fails AVS (Address Verification) checks, void it using the transactionId from that failed attempt.
How do I refund a transaction?In doc

Source: WeVend WePay API Gateway v3.2.2, p.78–79 — /api/payments/refund-with-token

Call POST /api/payments/refund-with-token for a Sale or completed Pre-Auth. Required fields: amount, orderId, mid, termId, transactionId, redirectUrl.

Refunds support a specific amount field — meaning partial refunds are possible, not just full reversals.
Does the API support disputes or chargebacks?

No — the documentation only covers merchant-initiated void and refund actions. Dispute intake, chargeback workflows, and representment are not part of this API and would need to be confirmed directly with WeVend.

☁️

Hosting & Deployment

Do we need to deploy the API Gateway ourselves?

No. The API Gateway is fully hosted and managed by WeVend. No deployment is required on the integrator's side.

The localhost:3000 URL shown in the documentation is only a local-development example — it doesn't represent anything you need to host.
